newsitem.title: USA: Ford hopes to resume Contour production.
newsitem.headline: Ford hopes to resume Contour production.

text.p: Ford Motor Co said Thursday it hopes to re-start production of Contour and Mystique sedans at its Kansas City assembly plant Monday after a shortage of components forced a halt this week.

Ford spokesman Joel Pitcoff said production of the 1998 model Ford Contours and Mercury Mystiques was halted Monday of this week. The move idled more than 2,000 workers. It is Ford's only plant that makes the sedans.
Production of F-Series pickup trucks, which are made at a different part of the Kansas City plant, was not affected.
Located in the Kansas City suburb of Claycomo, Mo., the plant employs a total of 5,139 hourly workers. Total unit production of both assembly lines in 1995 was 391,834.
